content.title: Why Booz Allen Stock Took a Beating After Treasury Contract Cancellations
content.summary: Shares of defense technology and consulting firm  Booz Allen  Hamilton fell 8% Monday after the Treasury Department announced that it was cancelling all its contracts, valued at $21 million, over leaked tax returns.  Monday’s cuts reignite fears that the company is “at risk of being made an example of by the Administration,” Stifel analyst Jonathan Siegmann, said.  “Today’s statement by the [Treasury] Secretary is a set-back.”
